project.title: Cross-site Quality Management System Rollout
project.objective: Plan and execute the rollout of a standardized quality management system across all sites, ensuring compliance, consistent processes, and clear project governance.
deliverables: Documented cross-site quality management framework and process map
Standard operating procedures and work instructions for key processes
Quality KPI dashboard and reporting cadence definition
Training plan and completed training records for all impacted roles
Risk and compliance register for the new quality management system
Post-rollout review report with improvement backlog
constraints: Rollout must be completed within 30 days with no disruption to critical operations
All procedures must comply with existing legal and regulatory requirements
Limited budget for external consulting and tooling changes
Must reuse current tools where possible instead of procuring new platforms
Training must be delivered mostly asynchronously due to shift patterns

risks.risk: Operational teams resist adopting new standardized procedures.
risks.mitigation: Engage site representatives early, run pilot, collect feedback, and adjust SOPs before full rollout.

risks.risk: Incomplete mapping of existing processes leads to gaps in the quality framework.
risks.mitigation: Run structured process discovery workshops and peer review of process maps by multiple quality engineers.

risks.risk: Training is not completed by all impacted staff before go-live.
risks.mitigation: Track training completion via dashboard, escalate to line managers, and provide short refresher sessions.

risks.risk: Regulatory requirements are misinterpreted or partially implemented.
risks.mitigation: Involve compliance officer in reviews and perform targeted compliance checks on high-risk processes.

risks.risk: KPI definitions are inconsistent across sites, making data unreliable.
risks.mitigation: Define KPI dictionary centrally, validate with site leads, and run a 2-week parallel reporting test.

themes.why_relevant: Core of the rollout is aligning disparate site practices into one coherent quality system.
New system must meet legal and regulatory requirements while managing operational risks.
Staff adoption depends on clear training, communication, and support during transition.
Consistent metrics are needed to monitor quality performance across all sites.
Tight deadline and limited budget require clear prioritization and scope management.

backlog.task: Define and approve the cross-site quality management framework and governance model
definition_of_done: Framework document drafted and shared with stakeholders
Governance roles and decision rights clearly defined
Sign-off received from operations manager and compliance officer

backlog.task: Map current key operational processes across all sites and identify gaps
definition_of_done: Process maps created for all agreed key processes
Gaps and variations between sites documented
Gap summary reviewed with project manager

backlog.task: Draft standardized SOPs and work instructions for high-risk processes
definition_of_done: SOP templates aligned with compliance requirements
Draft SOPs created for all high-risk processes
Peer review completed and comments resolved

backlog.task: Create project plan, milestones, and communication plan for the rollout
definition_of_done: Detailed project schedule with milestones published
Communication plan with key messages and channels defined
Plan validated with site supervisors

backlog.task: Define quality KPIs, targets, and reporting cadence for all sites
definition_of_done: KPI dictionary with definitions and formulas completed
Targets agreed with operations manager
Reporting cadence and owners documented

backlog.task: Design and document the training curriculum for the new quality system
definition_of_done: Training modules and learning objectives defined
Training materials drafted and reviewed
Training plan aligned with shift schedules

backlog.task: Execute pilot rollout of the quality management system at one site
definition_of_done: Pilot site selected and scope agreed
Pilot executed according to plan
Pilot feedback collected and documented

backlog.task: Perform compliance and risk assessment on the new SOPs
definition_of_done: Compliance checklist applied to all new SOPs
Risks logged in risk register with owners
Mitigation actions agreed with project manager

backlog.task: Roll out training to all impacted staff across sites
definition_of_done: Training schedule communicated to all sites
Attendance and completion tracked in training log
Minimum agreed completion rate achieved before go-live

backlog.task: Set up and validate the quality KPI dashboard and reporting process
definition_of_done: Dashboard structure and data sources defined
Test data run for at least one reporting cycle
Data accuracy validated with site supervisors

backlog.task: Monitor first month of operation and capture improvement backlog
definition_of_done: Issues and incidents logged and categorized
Improvement items prioritized with stakeholders
Post-rollout review report shared

backlog.task: Create and publish a quick-reference checklist for site supervisors
definition_of_done: Checklist drafted based on finalized SOPs
Reviewed by at least one site supervisor
Published and linked in central documentation

artifacts.title: Cross-site Quality Management Framework
artifacts.used_for: Defines overall quality system structure, governance, and key principles for all sites.

artifacts.title: Standard Operating Procedures Pack
artifacts.used_for: Consolidated SOPs and work instructions for high-risk and core processes.

artifacts.title: Quality KPI Dictionary and Dashboard Spec
artifacts.used_for: Lists KPIs, formulas, targets, and dashboard layout for reporting.

artifacts.title: Training Curriculum and Delivery Guide
artifacts.used_for: Outlines training modules, audience, and delivery approach for the rollout.

artifacts.title: Site Supervisor Quality Readiness Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Quick reference for supervisors to confirm readiness before and after go-live.

artifacts.title: Risk and Compliance Register
artifacts.used_for: Tracks identified risks, compliance checks, owners, and mitigation status.

artifacts.title: Pilot Rollout Feedback Log
artifacts.used_for: Captures issues, suggestions, and lessons learned from the pilot site.

artifacts.title: Post-rollout Review and Improvement Backlog
artifacts.used_for: Summarizes outcomes of first month and lists prioritized improvements.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, governance, and overall rollout plan for the quality system.
threads_plan.trigger: project manager posts initial project brief and draft framework for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve or adjust the proposed quality management framework and governance model.
Confirm the list of key processes to be included in the first rollout wave.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Converge on standardized SOPs and risk/compliance approach.
threads_plan.trigger: quality engineer shares first batch of SOP drafts and gap analysis.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on final SOP template and approval workflow for all sites.
Decide on risk prioritization criteria for the risk and compliance register.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock in KPI set, targets, and reporting cadence for the dashboard.
threads_plan.trigger: project manager posts draft KPI dictionary and sample dashboard views.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Finalize the core KPI list and definitions for cross-site reporting.
Confirm reporting cadence and data owners for each KPI.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on training approach, schedule, and pilot site for the rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: quality engineer shares training curriculum draft and pilot proposal.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the pilot site and define pilot success criteria.
Approve the training curriculum and high-level rollout schedule.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review early results post-go-live and prioritize improvement backlog.
threads_plan.trigger: project manager posts first month performance summary and issues list.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each participant posts yesterday-today-blockers in one thread.
Twice-weekly risk and issue review summarizing new items from the risk register.
Weekly SOP and training content review focusing on open comments and approvals.
End-of-milestone retrospective thread capturing lessons learned and action items.
